FICTIONAL TEST REPORT
ULTRASOUND PELVIS, TRANSABDOMINAL AND TRANSVAGINAL
Date of examination: 24/05/2025
Clinical details: Pelvic pain and irregular periods.
FINDINGS:
The uterus is anteverted and measures 8.2 x 4.1 x 4.8 cm. The endometrial thickness is 9 mm. There is a subserosal fibroid on the posterior fundal wall measuring 31 x 28 mm, and a second intramural fibroid measuring 12 mm on the left anterior wall. The right ovary measures 3.6 x 2.1 x 2.4 cm and appears normal. The left ovary contains a unilocular cyst with thin walls and no solid component, measuring 46 x 41 mm, with homogeneous low level echoes. There is no internal flow on colour Doppler. A small volume of free fluid is seen in the pouch of Douglas. Both adnexa are otherwise unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. Two uterine fibroids, the larger 31 mm.
2. 46 mm left ovarian cyst, probably haemorrhagic; repeat ultrasound in 6 to 8 weeks.
